correctness.rationale: The weak-null finite-block component tends to zero strongly, and coordinate truncation of a weak-null ell_p tail proves ||v+w_n||_p^p-||w_n||_p^p->||v||_p^p. Extract a scalar tail-norm subsequence for the upper variational bound and use ae_{n+1} for exact reverse attainment. Oppositely order equal-norm pure finite/tail vectors to obtain the iff p-sum rigidity. Apply the two-sided mixed-norm Minkowski bounds with r=min(p,q), s=max(p,q) and maximize ((1+t^r)^(1/r))/((1+t^s)^(1/s)) at t=1; pure-finite/pure-tail vectors give equality, including q=1,infinity and p=q.
